summary: The Oasis is planned as a persistent community hub: arrive in a central Hub, find worlds made by others, personalize a player-owned avatar and Home, or create a world. Today the public project is defining the experience and foundation; the product itself is not live.

currentWork.title: One portable Oasis experience blueprint
currentWork.detail: Hub-first arrival, returning choices, player-owned avatar, Home, discovery, creation, exact resume and explicit recovery are recorded as requirements and proposals; application behavior has not started.

currentWork.title: A traceable phased plan
currentWork.detail: F0–F1 and S1–S5 have dependencies, stable task IDs, acceptance gates and explicit unknowns; no dates or percentages are invented.

currentWork.title: A place to contribute
currentWork.detail: Public source, contribution guidance, governance, conduct, Discussions and private security reporting are available.

currentWork.title: The Oasis project identity
currentWork.detail: The existing public repository has been renamed in place and the local origin points to it. New-brand Pages source and the live migrated revision still await protected publication evidence.

currentWork.title: Progress that follows the source
currentWork.detail: The Oasis status and five-page site source are implemented. The protected main checks and Pages deployment for this new source still need live verification.

milestones.title: Existing community foundation
milestones.detail: Consolidated project, provenance, GitHub contribution workflow and evidence-led Pages site.

milestones.title: The Oasis definition
milestones.detail: Hub-centered product blueprint, requirement/decision traceability, portable contributor guidance and in-place repository migration are implemented; protected publication and live Pages verification remain separate evidence gates.

milestones.title: Internal local Oasis proof
milestones.detail: Local Hub/dashboard/avatar/Home entry plus dual-authoring World SDK, interpreted guest runtime, two original scenes, player-owned personalization, exact resume and recoverable local save/export.

milestones.title: Accounts and shared core
milestones.detail: Stage durable account/profile/location/Home ownership and eligible discovery, then authoritative shared Hub/rooms/text with changed-client permission tests.

milestones.title: Proximity and party voice
milestones.detail: Authorized media routes, recipient/lifecycle behavior, resource limits and forbidden-delivery evidence.

milestones.title: Trusted world publishing
milestones.detail: Validated compatible immutable releases, current grants, direct publishing, rollback, quarantine and revocation.

milestones.title: Public readiness
milestones.detail: Worldwide all-age eligibility, privacy, accessibility, rights, actual devices, staffed operations and sustainable finances require evidence before release.

contributionAreas.title: Research
contributionAreas.detail: Verify assumptions with current primary sources and make evidence, confidence and tradeoffs clear.

contributionAreas.title: Accessibility
contributionAreas.detail: Review first arrival, consistent navigation, keyboard alternatives, recovery and readable project information.

contributionAreas.title: Architecture
contributionAreas.detail: Help define small, testable identity, avatar, Home, world and runtime boundaries before implementation.

contributionAreas.title: Documentation
contributionAreas.detail: Improve acceptance criteria, contributor onboarding, traceability and evidence quality.

limits: No real login, playable Hub/Home/worlds, avatar wardrobe, world directory, online identity, multiplayer, chat, voice or user publishing exists yet. S1 application work is unstarted. Proposals and research do not establish runtime security, accessibility conformance, device coverage, age/privacy protection, legal readiness or public operations.
